title: Vivien Oswell
paragraphs: Vivien Oswell, age 96, recently completed a commissioned acrylic painting of Wychmere Harbor in Harwich Port.

Vivien Oswell began receiving awards for her paintings in 1954. Sixty-five years later she just completed a large commissioned acrylic painting. Living near Nantucket Sound, the sea is a familiar and a loved subject of Vivien’s paintbrush. Vivien is a past-president of the Cape Cod Art Association and the Harwich Guild of Artists. She credits God as the source of her inspiration and talent. And at 96, she still wakes up looking forward to spending the day painting.
Vivien’s work is currently displayed at the Galleries at 820 Main St Gallery, Harwich Port.

pwsbuilder August 27, 2019

The Guild of Harwich Artists is proud to announce a reception for founding member Vivien Oswell, on Thursday, September 19th, 4-6pm. You are invited to an open-house reception and art show honoring Vivien at the Cape Cod Community Media Center, 17 Shad Hole Rd, Dennis Port, MA 02639; Tel: (508) 394-2388. Refreshments will be served. Come meet Vivien and view some of her recent work.

For Art and Community
Vivien Oswell began receiving awards for her paintings in 1954. Sixty-five years later she just completed a large commissioned acrylic painting. Living near Nantucket Sound, the sea is a familiar and a loved subject of Vivien’s paintbrush. Vivien is a past-president of the Cape Cod Art Association and the Harwich Guild of Artists. She credits God as the source of her inspiration and talent. And at 96, she still wakes up looking forward to spending the day painting.

Vivien’s work is currently displayed at the Galleries at 820 Main St Gallery, Harwich Port.
